what: TR2 fund links: which topic cohorts each sector fund holds, by weight. Local files only; study output, nothing written to any table.

as_of.file_says: Fund holdings as [ticker, weight %] rows. 51 funds from the 26 Sep FMP file; 74 funds pulled fresh from FMP on 28 Sep on Fly. International funds keep rows down to 0.02% (top 400).
as_of.note: the 26 Sep file carries no per-fund date; the 28 Sep pull carries FMP's own "updated" stamp per fund
as_of.tree: CO1 proposal.json built 2026-10-06T15:44:29.139283Z, as TR1 loaded it (QRVO and IDX_ sets out)

method.held: the fund lists the ticker with a weight above zero
method.fund_weight_pct: sum of the fund's weights on the cohort's members = how much of the FUND the cohort is
method.sector_parent_rule: rank sectors by names held by the sector's Vanguard fund; ties by SPDR weight, then Vanguard weight
method.cross_sector_rule: second sector's Vanguard fund holds at least 25% of the cohort's names
method.heading: union of the cohorts whose FIRST parent is the heading, each ticker counted once
method.coverage_pct: share of the fund's weight on tickers in the 590 served symbols, each ticker once
method.weights: percent of fund, rounded to 3 decimals; not rescaled to 100
